questions.question: The difference between the cubes of two given natural numbers is 6272 , while the positive difference between the two given numbers is 8. What is the sum of the cubes of the two given numbers?
questions.solution:
**Given:-**

x³ - y³ = 6272 

x - y = 8

**Formula used:-**

( A³ + B³) = ( A + B)³ - 3AB( A + B) 

( A3 - B3) = ( A - B)3 + 3AB( A - B)

**Calculation:-**

According to the formula, 

x3 - y3 = ( x - y )³ + 3xy(x - y) 

⇒ ( x - y )3 + 3xy(x - y) = 6272 

⇒ 8³ + 3xy(8) = 6272 

⇒24xy = 6272 - 512 = 5760 

⇒ xy = 240 .....(1)

Now,

(x - y) = 8 [Given]

Square both sides,

(x - y)² = 64 

⇒ x² + y² - 2xy = 64 

⇒ x2 + y2 = 64 + 2× 240 [ xy = 240] 

⇒ x2 + y2 = 544 ....(2)

We know that

(x + y)² = x² + y² + 2xy 

⇒ (x + y)2 = 544 + 2× 240 

⇒ (x + y)2 = 1024 

⇒ (x + y) = 32

As per the question,

 x3 + y3 = ( x + y )3 - 3xy(x + y) 

⇒ x3 + y3 = 32³ - 3 × 32 × 240 

⇒ 32768 - 23040 = 9728 

**∴ The required answer is __9728.__**

questions.question: If 2x + 3y = 16 and xy = 9, then find 8x³ + 27y³
questions.solution:
**Given:-**

2x + 3y = 16 and xy = 9

**Concept used:-**

(a + b)³ = a³ + b³ + 3ab(a + b)

**Calculation:-**

a3 + b3 = (a + b)3 - 3ab(a + b)

8x3 + 27y3

⇒ (2x)³ + (3y)³

⇒ (2x + 3y)³ - 3 × 2x × 3y (2x + 3y)

⇒ (2x + 3y)3 - 18xy (2x + 3y)

⇒ 16³ - 18 × 9 × 16

⇒ 4096 - 2592

⇒ 1504

**∴ The required answer is 1504.**

questions.question:
In the following figure, O is the centre of the circle. Its two chords AB and CD intersect each other at point P inside the circle. If AB = 18 cm, PB = 6 cm and CP = 4 cm, then find the measure of PD.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/22bcd7b8cb54a222b8256a2528a3c808d3534dac164e7128413298d806e02785.png]
questions.solution:
**Given:-**

Two chords AB and CD intersect each other at point P.

AB = 18 cm, PB = 6 cm, and CP = 4 cm

**Formula used:-**

If two chords AB and CD intersect each other at point P inside the circle,

then AP × PB = CP × PD

**Calculation:-**

AP = AB - PB

⇒ AP = 18 - 6 = 12 cm

According to the formula

AP × PB = CP × PD

⇒ 12 × 6 = 4 × PD

⇒ PD = 72/4

**∴ The required answer is __18.__**

questions.question: If x + y = 25 and xy = 20, then find the value of x³ + y³.
questions.solution:

x + y = 25 and xy = 20

**Formula used:-**

(x + y)³ = x³ + y³ + 3xy(x + y)

**Calculation:- **

⇒ 25³ = x³ + y³ + 3 × 20×25 

⇒ 15625 = x³ + y³ + 1500 

⇒ x3 + y3 = 15625 − 1500 = 14125 

**∴ The required answer is __14125__.**

questions.question: Sohan and Amit started a car race from the same point in the same direction and at the same time on a circular track of length 1125 m with speeds of 36 km/h and 54 km/h, respectively. After how much time (in seconds) will they meet for the first time since the start of the race?
questions.solution:
**Given:- **

Sohan's speed = 36 km/h = (36 × 1000 m) / (3600 s) = 10 m/s

Amit's speed = 54 km/h = (54 ×1000 m) / (3600 s) = 15 m/s

**Formula used:-**

Two trains/bodies are moving in the same direction at u m/s & v m/s,

where u>v then the relative speed in the same direction = (u - v) m/s.

**Calculation:-**

Relative speed = Amit's speed - Sohan's speed 

⇒15 m/s - 10 m/s = 5 m/s

Time (t) = Distance (d) / Relative Speed

Time (t) = 1125 m / 5 m/s = 225 seconds

**∴ Sohan and Amit will meet for the first time since the start of the race after__ 225 __seconds**.

questions.question: Two motorists start together to travel to a certain destination, one at the speed of 4 km/h and the other at the speed of 6 km/h. Find the distance travelled by them (in km) if the motorist travelling at 4 km/h arrives half an hour after the other motorist.
questions.solution:
**Given:-**

Speed of first man = 4 km/hr

Speed of second man = 6 km/h

**Formula used:- **

Distance = Speed x Time 

**Calculation:- **

Distance = 4 ×T

For the second motorist (traveling at 6 km/h)

Distance = 6 × (T - 0.5) 

Their distances must be the same 

⇒ Distance1 = Distance2 

⇒ 4T = 6(T - 0.5) 

⇒ T = 3/2 Hours

Distance = 4 km/h × (3/2) hours = 6 km

**∴ The motorist traveling at 4 km/h traveled a distance of__ 6 km t__o reach the destination.**

questions.question: A man, a woman and a boy can complete a job in 3, 5 and 15 days, respectively. How many boys must assist 1 man and 1 woman to complete the job in (1)/(5) of a day?
questions.solution:
**Detailed solution:-**

Man's 1-day work = 1/3

Woman's 1-day work = 1/5

Boy's 1-day work = 1/15

According to the question-

⇒ 1 × (1/3) + 1 × (1/5) + x × (1/15) = 1/(1/5)

{ ∵ x be the no. of boys needed}

⇒ x/15 = 5 - (1/3) - (1/5)

⇒ x/15 = (75 - 5 - 3)/15

⇒ x = 67 

**∴__ 67__ Boys are needed to complete the work.**

questions.question: A hemispherical bowl has a radius of 7 cm. It is to be painted from inside as well as outside. Find the cost of painting it at the rate of Rs.40 per 20 cm²? (Take thickness of the bowl as negligible).
questions.solution:
**Given:- **

A hemispherical bowl has a radius = 7cm 

The cost of painting it at the rate of Rs.40 per 20 cm² 

**Formula used:-**

Curved Surface Area of Hemisphere = 2πr²

**Calculation:- **

Inside Surface Area = 2π(7 cm)² = 2 × 22/7 × 49 = 308 cm²

Outside Surface Area = 2π(7 cm)² = 308 cm²

Total Surface Area = Inside Surface Area + Outside Surface Area

Total Surface Area = 616cm² 

The cost of painting this area at the given rate of Rs. 40 for 20 cm²

Cost = (Total Surface Area / 20 cm²) × Rs. 40

Cost = (616 / 20) × 40 = 1232 Rs. 

**∴The cost of painting both the inside and outside of the hemispherical Rs.__1232__.**

questions.question: If A, B and C can do a work in 6 days, 9 days and 11 days, respectively, then, working together, how many days will they take to do the work?
questions.solution:
**Detailed solution:- **

Let's denote the work rates of A, B, and C as follows

A's work rate = 1/6 

B's work rate = 1/9 

C's work rate = 1/11

Total work = A's work + B's work + C's work

Total work = (1/6) + (1/9) + (1/11)

⇒ (33/198) + (22/198) + (18/198) = 73 / 198 

Time taken to complete the work together = 1 / Total work rate

Time taken = 1 / (73/198)

Time is taken = 198 / 73 = 2 (52)/(73) 

**∴ It would take 2 (52)/(73) days for A, B, and C to complete the work together. **

questions.question: On selling a painting at Rs. 1,498 , the gain is 25% more than the loss incurred on selling it at Rs.1,300. In order to gain 25%, the selling price will be:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

1st Selling price (S.P) = Rs.1498 

2nd selling price (S.P) = Rs.1300

**Formula used:**

Profit = (S.P - C.P)

Loss = (C.P - S.P)

S.P = C.P × (100 ± P/L)

Where, C.P = cost price; S.P = Selling price

**Calculation:**

According to the question:

⇒ (1498 - C.P) = 125% × (C.P - 1300)

⇒ (1498 - C.P) = (5/4) × (C.P - 1300)

⇒ 4 × (1498 - C.P) = 5 × (C.P - 1300)

⇒ 5992 - 4C.P = 5C.P - 6500

⇒ 9C.P = (6500 + 5992)

⇒ C.P = 12492/9 = Rs.1388

Required S.P = C.P × (100 + 25)% = 1388 × 125% = Rs.1735

**∴ The correct answer is Rs.1735.**
